description: Regional data: "income" (residents income per capita by municipality, or county with level "powiat"), "pit" (PIT due per resident from tax returns by municipality and province, by type of return, PIT-38 capital gains returns per 1000 residents, finwire_pit_per_capita; with name = one municipality year by year), "local-tax" (finwire_local_tax_squeeze: property tax as % of property tax + PIT share in municipal budget plans, provinces, cities, municipalities in the squeeze, upper limit of the property tax rate for flats; with name = matching municipalities), "unemployment" (registered unemployment by province), "wages" (average wage by province). Filter by name.

year.description: For pit: tax year; for local-tax: budget year; default latest.
